title: Log Striping using stone cutter!
description: This datapack adds a new feature that helps u convert normal logs to stripped logs using a stone cutter.
body:
This datapack adds a new feature that helps u convert normal logs to stripped logs using a stone cutter. 

It works on 1.21.x and maybe on 1.20.x, but i havent tested in 1.20.x
 
(https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bcbd4856276ab4d0a9812f21b792e22e9314489.png)

INSTALLATION

Go to your world folder->datapacks-> and put this datapack

If the datapack is not working, try /datapack enable (datapack name) in game

To find the datapack name do /datapack list

Download this datapack on curseforge if u like here:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/log-striping-using-stone-cutter
